newsitem.title: USA: Altera sets two-for-one stock split.
newsitem.headline: Altera sets two-for-one stock split.

text.p: Altera Corp said on Wednesday it has set a two-for-one stock split to be paid on January 6 to shareholders of record on December 18.
Shares will begin trading on a post-split basis on January 7, the company said in a statement.

"The stock split is in response to the increase in the market price for the company's stock throughout this quarter," Chief Executive Officer Rodney Smith said in a statement. "We feel this is a good opportunity to increase the availability of shares for trading and possibly to broaden our stockholder base." Altera last split its stock on June 1, 1995.
